metadata.notes: Manual Copilot generation for stage-3 records; protected source fields were kept unchanged.

word_meaning.meaning_en: the joint between the foot and the leg

word_example.example_en: She hurt her ankle during the match.
word_example.example_zh: 她在比赛中伤到了脚踝。

word_example.example_en: The doctor checked my swollen ankle carefully.
word_example.example_zh: 医生仔细检查了我肿胀的脚踝。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the yearly date of an important event

word_example.example_en: Today is their wedding anniversary at home.
word_example.example_zh: 今天是他们在家庆祝的结婚纪念日。

word_example.example_en: The school marked its hundredth anniversary proudly.
word_example.example_zh: 学校自豪地庆祝了百年校庆。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to make something known publicly or officially

word_example.example_en: The teacher will announce results after lunch.
word_example.example_zh: 老师将在午饭后宣布结果。

word_example.example_en: They announced the plan on local radio.
word_example.example_zh: 他们在当地广播里宣布了计划。

word_meaning.meaning_en: an official statement or public notice

word_example.example_en: The morning announcement changed our class schedule.
word_example.example_zh: 早晨的通知改变了我们的课程表。

word_example.example_en: A short announcement ended the busy meeting.
word_example.example_zh: 一则简短通知结束了那场忙碌的会议。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to make someone slightly angry or impatient

word_example.example_en: Loud tapping can annoy everyone in class.
word_example.example_zh: 大声敲击会让班里每个人烦躁。

word_example.example_en: His rude joke annoyed her all afternoon.
word_example.example_zh: 他粗鲁的玩笑让她整个下午都很烦。

word_meaning.meaning_en: happening once every year
word_meaning.meaning_zh: a.每年的，年度的，一年一次的

word_example.example_en: The annual sports day begins next week.
word_example.example_zh: 一年一度的运动会下周开始。

word_example.example_en: They published an annual report for shareholders.
word_example.example_zh: 他们为股东发布了年度报告。

word_meaning.meaning_en: one more; a different one

word_example.example_en: Can I have another piece of cake?
word_example.example_zh: 我能再来一块蛋糕吗？

word_example.example_en: She chose another route to the station.
word_example.example_zh: 她选择了另一条去车站的路线。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a reply or solution; to reply to someone

word_example.example_en: Her answer surprised the entire math class.
word_example.example_zh: 她的回答让整个数学班都很惊讶。

word_example.example_en: Please answer the email before dinner tonight.
word_example.example_zh: 请在今晚晚饭前回复这封邮件。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a very small insect that lives in groups

word_example.example_en: An ant carried food across the stone.
word_example.example_zh: 一只蚂蚁把食物搬过了石头。

word_example.example_en: The child watched ants beside the tree.
word_example.example_zh: 那个孩子看着树旁边的蚂蚁。

word_meaning.meaning_en: relating to the South Pole region

word_example.example_en: Antarctic winds can be extremely cold.
word_example.example_zh: 南极的风可能极其寒冷。

word_example.example_en: Scientists study Antarctic animals each winter.
word_example.example_zh: 科学家每年冬天研究南极动物。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the Antarctic region around the South Pole

word_example.example_en: Many explorers once dreamed of the Antarctic.
word_example.example_zh: 许多探险家曾梦想前往南极。

word_example.example_en: Research ships travel to the Antarctic yearly.
word_example.example_zh: 科研船每年都前往南极。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the continent around the South Pole

word_example.example_en: Antarctica is covered with ice and snow.
word_example.example_zh: 南极洲被冰雪覆盖。

word_example.example_en: Few people live permanently in Antarctica.
word_example.example_zh: 很少有人永久居住在南极洲。

word_meaning.meaning_en: an old valuable object; old and valuable

word_example.example_en: The museum displayed one rare antique vase.
word_example.example_zh: 博物馆展出了一只罕见的古董花瓶。

word_example.example_en: Her grandfather collects antique clocks for fun.
word_example.example_zh: 她祖父以收藏古董钟为乐。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a feeling of worry or fear about something

word_example.example_en: Exam anxiety kept him awake all night.
word_example.example_zh: 考试焦虑让他整夜未眠。

word_example.example_en: Her anxiety faded after the doctor's call.
word_example.example_zh: 接到医生电话后，她的焦虑消退了。

word_meaning.meaning_en: worried or eager about something that may happen

word_example.example_en: Parents felt anxious during the long storm.
word_example.example_zh: 在漫长的暴风雨中，父母感到焦急。

word_example.example_en: She is anxious to hear the result.
word_example.example_zh: 她急切地想听到结果。

word_meaning.meaning_en: one, some, or every without being exact
word_meaning.meaning_zh: pron.（无论）哪一个；哪些任何的

word_example.example_en: Do you have any fresh bread left?
word_example.example_zh: 你还有新鲜面包吗？

word_example.example_en: Any student can join the music club.
word_example.example_zh: 任何学生都可以加入音乐社。

word_meaning.meaning_en: any person at all

word_example.example_en: Did anybody call while I was out?
word_example.example_zh: 我出去时有人打电话吗？

word_example.example_en: Anybody can learn with enough patience.
word_example.example_zh: 只要有足够耐心，任何人都能学会。

word_meaning.meaning_en: in any case or in a careless way

word_example.example_en: The bus was late, but we went anyhow.
word_example.example_zh: 公交车晚了，但我们还是去了。

word_example.example_en: He smiled and thanked us anyhow.
word_example.example_zh: 不管怎样，他还是笑着感谢了我们。

word_meaning.meaning_en: any person at all

word_example.example_en: Anyone can use this public reading room.
word_example.example_zh: 任何人都可以使用这个公共阅览室。

word_example.example_en: Has anyone seen my blue notebook today?
word_example.example_zh: 今天有人看见我的蓝色笔记本吗？

word_meaning.meaning_en: any thing, no matter what it is

word_example.example_en: Do you need anything from the store?
word_example.example_zh: 你需要我从商店带什么吗？

word_example.example_en: Anything seems possible on a clear morning.
word_example.example_zh: 在晴朗的早晨，一切似乎皆有可能。

word_meaning.meaning_en: in any case; anyway

word_example.example_en: The road was blocked, but we left anywa.
word_example.example_zh: 路被堵住了，但我们还是出发了。

word_example.example_en: I thanked him anywa before boarding.
word_example.example_zh: 登机前我还是感谢了他。

word_meaning.meaning_en: in or to any place at all

word_example.example_en: You can sit anywhere in this room.
word_example.example_zh: 你可以坐在这个房间的任何地方。

word_example.example_en: We could not find the key anywhere.
word_example.example_zh: 我们哪儿都找不到那把钥匙。

word_meaning.meaning_en: separated by distance or into pieces; except for

word_example.example_en: The two houses stand far apart today.
word_example.example_zh: 这两所房子今天相距很远。

word_example.example_en: Old books fall apart without proper care.
word_example.example_zh: 旧书如果照料不当就会散开。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a set of rooms for living in one building
word_meaning.meaning_zh: n.（美）楼中单元房，一套房间

word_example.example_en: They rented a small apartment near campus.
word_example.example_zh: 他们在校园附近租了一套小公寓。

word_example.example_en: The apartment has bright windows and plants.
word_example.example_zh: 那套公寓有明亮的窗户和植物。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to say sorry for something you did wrong

word_example.example_en: He came early to apologize for yesterday.
word_example.example_zh: 他早早来了，为昨天的事道歉。

word_example.example_en: Please apologize to your partner after class.
word_example.example_zh: 请在课后向你的搭档道歉。

word_meaning.meaning_en: an expression of regret for doing something wrong

word_example.example_en: Her sincere apology calmed the angry group.
word_example.example_zh: 她真诚的道歉让愤怒的人群平静下来。

word_example.example_en: He sent an apology by email tonight.
word_example.example_zh: 他今晚通过邮件发去了道歉。

word_meaning.meaning_en: easy to notice or understand; clear

word_example.example_en: It became apparent that the map was wrong.
word_example.example_zh: 地图有误这一点变得显而易见。

word_example.example_en: Her skill was apparent from the start.
word_example.example_zh: 她的能力从一开始就显而易见。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to make a serious request or be attractive to someone

word_example.example_en: The film may appeal to young viewers.
word_example.example_zh: 这部电影可能会吸引年轻观众。

word_example.example_en: They filed an appeal after the verdict.
word_example.example_zh: 判决后他们提出了上诉。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to come into sight or seem to be true

word_example.example_en: Stars appear one by one after sunset.
word_example.example_zh: 星星在日落后一个接一个出现。

word_example.example_en: A solution began to appear in discussion.
word_example.example_zh: 解决办法开始在讨论中显现出来。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the way someone looks or the act of arriving

word_example.example_en: Her sudden appearance shocked everyone inside.
word_example.example_zh: 她的突然露面让里面所有人都震惊。

word_example.example_en: Clean appearance matters during a job interview.
word_example.example_zh: 求职面试时整洁的外表很重要。

word_meaning.meaning_en: extra material at the end of a book; a body organ

word_example.example_en: Check the appendix for extra reading notes.
word_example.example_zh: 查看附录以获取额外阅读笔记。

word_example.example_en: The surgeon removed his appendix last year.
word_example.example_zh: 外科医生去年切除了他的阑尾。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the desire to eat food

word_example.example_en: The cold air increased my appetite tonight.
word_example.example_zh: 寒冷的空气今晚增加了我的食欲。

word_example.example_en: Stress often reduces appetite before big exams.
word_example.example_zh: 压力常常会在大考前降低食欲。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to clap hands to show praise; the act of clapping

word_example.example_en: The audience applauded after the final song.
word_example.example_zh: 最后一首歌后，观众鼓掌了。

word_example.example_en: We applaud her courage during the crisis.
word_example.example_zh: 我们赞赏她在危机中的勇气。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a round fruit with red, green, or yellow skin

word_example.example_en: She packed an apple for school lunch.
word_example.example_zh: 她为学校午餐带了一个苹果。

word_example.example_en: The apple fell from the old tree.
word_example.example_zh: 那个苹果从老树上掉了下来。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a person who asks for a job, place, or service

word_example.example_en: Each applicant filled out the same form.
word_example.example_zh: 每位申请人都填写了同一张表。

word_example.example_en: The applicant arrived early for the interview.
word_example.example_zh: 那位申请人很早就到面试现场了。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a formal request for something such as a job or school place

word_example.example_en: Her college application was sent yesterday morning.
word_example.example_zh: 她的大学申请昨天早上寄出了。

word_example.example_en: We checked the job application together twice.
word_example.example_zh: 我们一起检查了两遍求职申请。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to request something formally or put something into use

word_example.example_en: You should apply for the science camp.
word_example.example_zh: 你应该申请那个科学夏令营。

word_example.example_en: Please apply this rule to every team.
word_example.example_zh: 请把这条规则应用到每个队伍。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to choose someone officially for a job or arrange a time

word_example.example_en: They appointed her leader of the project.
word_example.example_zh: 他们任命她为项目负责人。

word_example.example_en: The office will appoint a meeting time.
word_example.example_zh: 办公室将确定会议时间。

word_meaning.meaning_en: an arranged meeting or official position

word_example.example_en: I have a dentist appointment after school.
word_example.example_zh: 放学后我有个牙医预约。

word_example.example_en: His appointment with the manager was moved.
word_example.example_zh: 他与经理的约见被改期了。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to value something or feel grateful for it

word_example.example_en: We appreciate your help during this project.
word_example.example_zh: 我们感谢你在这个项目中的帮助。

word_example.example_en: She learned to appreciate classical piano music.
word_example.example_zh: 她学会了欣赏古典钢琴音乐。

word_meaning.meaning_en: gratitude or understanding of the value of something

word_example.example_en: Her speech showed appreciation for every volunteer.
word_example.example_zh: 她的讲话表达了对每位志愿者的感激。

word_example.example_en: Travel gave him appreciation of local culture.
word_example.example_zh: 旅行让他更加欣赏当地文化。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a way of dealing with something; to move nearer

word_example.example_en: We need a new approach to grammar.
word_example.example_zh: 我们需要一种新的语法学习方法。

word_example.example_en: A stranger began to approach the gate.
word_example.example_zh: 一个陌生人开始靠近大门。

word_meaning.meaning_en: suitable or right for a particular situation

word_example.example_en: Wear appropriate clothes for the formal dinner.
word_example.example_zh: 正式晚宴请穿合适的衣服。

word_example.example_en: His answer was appropriate and very polite.
word_example.example_zh: 他的回答恰当而且非常礼貌。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to agree with or officially accept something

word_example.example_en: The board will approve the new budget.
word_example.example_zh: 董事会将批准新的预算。

word_example.example_en: My parents did not approve that trip.
word_example.example_zh: 我父母并不同意那次旅行。

word_meaning.meaning_en: about but not exactly

word_example.example_en: The trip takes approximately three hours today.
word_example.example_zh: 今天这趟行程大约需要三个小时。

word_example.example_en: Approximately fifty people joined the clean-up.
word_example.example_zh: 大约五十人参加了这次清理活动。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the airport area where planes park

word_example.example_en: Several planes waited on the apron quietly.
word_example.example_zh: 几架飞机静静地停在停机坪上。

word_example.example_en: Workers crossed the apron in orange jackets.
word_example.example_zh: 工作人员穿着橙色夹克穿过停机坪。

word_meaning.meaning_en: based on personal choice rather than reason or system
word_meaning.meaning_zh: a.随心所欲的，独裁的，专断的

word_example.example_en: The rule felt arbitrary to many students.
word_example.example_zh: 这条规则让许多学生觉得很专断。

word_example.example_en: His arbitrary decision upset the whole team.
word_example.example_zh: 他武断的决定让整个团队都不满。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a curved structure over an opening

word_example.example_en: We stood under the old stone arch.
word_example.example_zh: 我们站在那座古老的石拱门下。

word_example.example_en: The bridge arch reflected in the river.
word_example.example_zh: 桥拱倒映在河里。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a person who designs buildings

word_example.example_en: The architect drew plans for the library.
word_example.example_zh: 建筑师为图书馆画了设计图。

word_example.example_en: An architect must balance beauty and safety.
word_example.example_zh: 建筑师必须平衡美感与安全。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the art or science of building design; a building style

word_example.example_en: Ancient architecture still influences modern cities.
word_example.example_zh: 古代建筑学仍影响着现代城市。

word_example.example_en: She wants to study architecture in college.
word_example.example_zh: 她想在大学学习建筑学。
